title: Agent Town HQ15Q Symbol-First Text Replacement Plan

screenshotFindings.primaryIssue: The gameplay model exists as tokens and command targets, but primary UI still explains nearly every token with prose.

rankedTargets.replacement: Compact icon rail plus icon-first command tray; move raw target IDs and server-state strings to accessible labels, tooltips, data attributes, or ledger detail.
rankedTargets.acceptanceGate: No visible raw cell IDs or server movement prose in primary command chips; all existing endpoint payload guards still pass.

rankedTargets.replacement: Use a single compressed command row or bottom command dock over the map; keep horizontal unit rail but reduce cards to symbols.
rankedTargets.acceptanceGate: At 390px and 366px, the map is visible in the first viewport and command items are not clipped.

rankedTargets.replacement: Glyph-count counters only in primary HUD; explanatory fog meanings move to collapsed Fog ledger and accessible labels.
rankedTargets.acceptanceGate: Primary HUD shows no explanatory fog prose; hidden and locked truth remains sealed.

rankedTargets.replacement: Symbol tray for selected cell, fog state, Scout eligibility, receipt count, and party avatars.
rankedTargets.acceptanceGate: No repeated fog, provenance, or Scout-eligibility prose is visible in the default selected summary.

rankedTargets.replacement: Compact zoom glyph cluster with current tier and mini count strip; explanatory copy moves to title/aria-label/help drawer.
rankedTargets.acceptanceGate: Desktop screenshot has no long semantic zoom sentence over the map.

rankedTargets.replacement: Default inspector becomes icon rail plus selected title; status, objective, metrics, fog legend, and authority copy collapse into Ledger/Receipts.
rankedTargets.acceptanceGate: Visible inspector no longer reads like a prose sidebar; proof details remain available when opened.

rankedTargets.replacement: Receipt cards use symbols first when opened; drawers remain audit views and add no actions.
rankedTargets.acceptanceGate: Drawers are collapsed by default and opening them exposes no executable actions or hidden truth.

rankedTargets.replacement: Hide fallback prose when Three.js renders; fallback keeps accessible map description.
rankedTargets.acceptanceGate: Three.js screenshots do not show fallback board prose.

HQ15R.name: unit/command compaction
HQ15R.goal: Remove the largest visible text block by compacting unit roster and command bar into symbols and icon controls.

HQ15S.name: fog/selected/inspector compaction
HQ15S.goal: Collapse secondary proof language and make fog, selected-sector, inspector, and zoom surfaces symbol-first.
mustPreserve: Event packet evidence collapsed by default

HQ15T.name: screenshot QA
HQ15T.goal: Prove with desktop/mobile screenshots and guardrail JSON that the default viewport no longer reads like a transcript.
mustCheck: no visible raw cell IDs in primary command bar
no visible long semantic zoom sentence in default viewport
no visible server movement prose in primary command bar
existing endpoint payload assertions still pass
